Bom Bom!! Kubfu and Intense Training (Japanese: ボムボム！！ダクマと超修業 Boom!! and Great Training) is the 35th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 

==Major events==
Oleana gives the antidote to Leon and the Gym Leaders, curing them from 's poison.
tries to enter the Tower of Darkness with Kubfu, but fails.
Kubfu tries to investigate the tower by itself, and is spotted by an .

==Trivia==
In VIZ Media's mini-volume publication, the title of this chapter is capitalized inconsistently. In the table of contents, it is formatted as "Bom bom!! Kubfu and Intense Training", while on the chapter's title page, it is formatted as "Bom Bom!! Kubfu and Intense Training".
